title: CB10: exclusion keys = CB9 q0182 keys + CB9 P and K/D frame ids + seal copies committed since q0182; series-date keys for the two ladder series
notes: CB10 q0201, PROMOTION-READY EXCEPT the two FILL_ sha256 pins and the review/freeze gates below. RELEASE ONLY WHEN: (1) science-reviewer ruling on reviews/CB10_Q0201_FIX_NOTE_2026-10-28.md is GO or GO_WITH_CHANGES with changes applied; (2) CB10 code-against-design freeze check done (cb10_rules_v2.json rules_sha256 d422cc70..., file sha256 5ee0ea23...; verify_rules passes on the committed file); (3) T_seal passed and q0200 smoke PASS (run_cb10 refuses before T_seal; a failed smoke stalls downstream, counted); (4) q0182b done (it is: keys sha256 e613604a... = exclusion_report.json keys_sha256), q0183 and q0185b done, and BOTH FILL_ pins replaced by the sha256 of the finished pyth frame.csv.gz and kd_frame_v3 sample.csv.gz on the host (sha256sum; both have a market_id column; a pin whose file is absent is recorded 'absent at q0201' and would silently shrink the exclusion set, so do not release with an absent pin); (5) the CB9 q0182b manifest/pins untouched. Behaviour: --normalise-ids (new, cb10_exclusion_fix.py) = q0182b mapping rule (composite h7_cb4_series ids -> numeric market part, pred_* market ids) + NOT_EXTRACTABLE seals counted in params.exclusion_fix.counts.n_not_extractable and per_pin (pred-only seals now contribute). Exit codes via cb9_exit: 0 only complete or declared stall (exclusion_keys_complete / disjointness_unverified); 75 transient incomplete (network, 429, should_stop, data-dumps or free-disk headroom); 1 non-transient; 4 disk budget; 2 refused. No repeat block: a transient stop exits 75 and the queue re-queues it (batches resume by position; the write-once sidecar refuses a changed id set). --budget-min is refused. >2% missing metadata -> disjointness unverified (D1, B1, B2 not testable, counted). --data-dumps-cap-gb 50 (ops 2026-10-28; design text says 14). resources mem_mb 1000 / as_cap_mb 3000 (as q0164c/q0182). Earlier notes: ops raised resources 2026-10-23 after q0182 MemoryError; data-dumps guard 40 -> 50 GiB 2026-10-28 (no rule, window or population changed). Draft stays in drafts/ until released. CB9 kd-cap amendment (2026-10-30, CREATIVE_BATCH_9.md section 11.4, ruling MUST 2): the K/D pin is the 1,000 seeded SCREEN+HOLDOUT markets, creative_batch9/kd_frame_v3/sample.csv.gz (design CB10 :184, CB9 :505; cb9_kd.py SAMPLE_FILE, market_id column), NOT the walked frame.csv.gz (250k-490k rows would break the ~300 Gamma-request / 0.005 GB budget) and never kd_frame/ (q0185 attempt, superseded, unread). Pyth pin stays the whole pyth frame. Add kd_frame_v3 to cb10_common.REFUSED_RUN_IDS at the next CB10 rules revision (ruling SHOULD 6). RELEASE CHECK (fix ruling 2026-10-30, SHOULD 5): run sha256sum on the host immediately before release and put the values in the two pins; after the run the manifest pins_absent must be EMPTY before q0202/q0204 start (an absent pin is recorded and exits 0, shrinking the exclusion set). Disclosure (SHOULD 7): params.exclusion_fix.counts.n_cb8_ids counts the CB9 q0182b key-file ids in this run. NOT_EXTRACTABLE seals and unparseable:* skipped copies are counted in params.exclusion_fix and carried into the D1/B1/B2 results as 'not verified against by id or event key' (disclosure only, no gate). params.exclusion_fix also records cb10_fix_module_sha256.
